purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 813 Maradi (city code 2168); local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
primaryPublisher: City and Regional authorities of Maradi; Niger Directorate General of Taxes (regional office structure)
registryBasis: Niger’s official Interior Ministry decentralisation handbook lists the Ville de Maradi as a distinct city-level local authority. An official ANP report describes a Maradi City land-affairs committee with participation from cadastral services and city/resident representation. National DGI materials list Maradi regional tax offices and cadastral functions, but none of these sources identifies an exact city-level title registry or public parcel-map service. Under the local-evidence threshold, registry existence is left unresolved (null).

officialSources.observation: Official Interior Ministry decentralisation handbook lists Ville de Maradi and city administrative structure; it contains no parcel-map service details.

Official ANP report records a city committee for land/flood displacement work in Maradi involving cadastral services and communal/regional actors; it does not describe public registry records or map access.

National DGI regulation identifies a Maradi regional property-tax office and lists cadastral/foncier functions at the national institutional level; it is regional/national evidence, not city parcel coverage.
National DGI organization chart lists regional DRI Maradi and national cadastral/land-finance services; no local geometry endpoint.
